asks: Which tools may an extension use?
answer: An extension can use only the tools it declares, and installing it grants them. Each tool names what it applies to: a path on a computer, the record of a computer, the requests of a computer, the app. A tool reads, shows or protects. Which tools Silo offers is settled when they are built.

sets.says: An extension can use only the tools it declares, and installing it grants them.
